title: IPKG aligned evaluation split pack (application to pipeline)
purpose: Fix ONE patient list per collection so the pipeline team tumour Dice and the co-author organ Dice are computed on identical patients.

basis.pipeline_test_lists: tumor_pools.global.<collection>.test, the split sam3_tumor_generic was trained under
basis.app_split_verification: recipe re-run independently (numpy RandomState(42) consumed once per dataset in dataset_order, sorted then shuffle, 20pct test / 10pct val / rest train); all 8 dataset x mode splits reproduced member-for-member
basis.app_twin_verification: voxel comparison under axis permutation and flips, exact equality; 57 pairs checked

conventions.pipeline_role_global_split: role under the GLOBAL split, the one sam3_tumor_generic was trained under, i.e. the round-2 evaluation split
conventions.pipeline_role_filtered_split: role under the per-dataset FILTERED split, the one the round-1 per-dataset AUSAM models were trained under
conventions.warning: the same patient has DIFFERENT roles in the two splits; a role is meaningless without naming the model
conventions.app_primary_cohort: twin-clean AND not a duplicate of an earlier-sorted test patient; this is the cohort we propose as primary

patients.twin_roles_global_split: FLARE23_0819=not in tumor pools;FLARE23_1774=not in tumor pools
